name: Component
summary: Components A thin managed face over an engine component. The handle is the C++ object; this class owns no state of its own, so two wrappers for the same component always agree. An interface, not a class, and that is forced rather than chosen. A script derives from ElintriaScript so the engine can create and run it, and a class gets one base - so a script cannot also derive from a Component class. An interface gives both: ElintriaScript implements it, the built-in components get it through ComponentBase, and a constraint accepts either.
